## Key Concepts
- CGO memory management and malloc/free across Go/C boundaries
- Translating Go slices to C contiguous buffers
- Numerically stable per-column statistics (mean/stddev)
- Error mapping from C to Go and memory cleanup
- Worker-pool orchestration and cancellation

- How would you validate JSON and propagate partial failures in a batch?
